overall: The AG found the Northborough Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving its July 6 minutes on August 14, its fourth meeting and more than 30 days later. No further remedy was ordered because the minutes were approved before the complaint was filed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve the minutes of its July 6 open meeting; the Board approved them August 14.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to approve meeting minutes in a timely manner

remedy: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a future finding of a similar violation may be considered an intent to violate the law.
